summary.text: Megan Jones is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 6 who assumed office on January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: In the 2025-2026 session Megan Jones chairs the House Local Government Committee and is assigned to the House State Government and House Ways and Means committees, according to Ballotpedia.
Jones advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
